rows.requirement: Hard eligibility checks run before advisory ranking and excluded candidates cannot be reintroduced.
rows.public_wording: Verdict filters candidates through hard eligibility gates before advisory ranking.
rows.gap: No live provider behavior is implied by this local contract evidence.

rows.requirement: Stale, unknown, malformed, and contradictory runtime signals fail closed instead of becoming ready.
rows.public_wording: Missing or stale runtime truth is represented explicitly and cannot silently authorize protected work.
rows.gap: Freshness depends on the supplied observation source; catalog membership alone remains insufficient.

rows.requirement: Capability and runtime passports preserve exact identity, provenance, freshness, authority, and limitations.
rows.public_wording: Passports separate declared, observed, and negotiated evidence for exact executable identities.
rows.gap: The passport contract does not itself execute a protocol or certify an external service.

rows.requirement: Runtime compatibility reports expose deterministic status, evidence states, limitations, remediation, and secret-safe identity.
rows.public_wording: Verdict can render a deterministic, fail-closed compatibility matrix from existing runtime passport evidence.
rows.gap: Live discovery, handshakes, probes, and protocol adapters remain separate work.

rows.requirement: Policy decisions and fallback transitions are versioned, deterministic, and legal before execution.
rows.public_wording: Routing policy and legal transition checks are deterministic and versioned.
rows.gap: A policy contract is not evidence that a particular provider route is healthy.

rows.requirement: Decision, execution, and outcome evidence is durable, scoped, tamper-evident, and privacy-safe.
rows.public_wording: Receipt contracts support scoped durable evidence with redaction and integrity checks.
rows.gap: Operators still need deployment-specific retention, access-control, and key-management decisions.

rows.requirement: Adaptive recommendations remain shadow-only until evidence, held-out evaluation, freshness, and rollback requirements pass.
rows.public_wording: Adaptive ranking is evidence-gated and has explicit rollback and kill-switch semantics.
rows.gap: No claim of measured model-quality improvement is authorized by this matrix.

rows.requirement: A deterministic demo exercises hard eligibility and can run without provider credentials or network access.
rows.public_wording: The repository includes a credential-free deterministic quickstart fixture with explicit exclusions.
rows.gap: The fixture is not a live-provider or production deployment demonstration.

rows.requirement: Benchmarks and evidence bundles have deterministic local verification paths and content digests.
rows.public_wording: Local benchmark fixtures and evidence bundles are reproducible and digest-verifiable.
rows.gap: Fixture results must not be presented as live provider quality, adoption, or performance.

rows.requirement: Repository CI includes lint, type, test, dependency, static security, and CodeQL checks.

evidence.locator: test, lint, security, type-check, install-smoke, build jobs

rows.verification: Inspect workflow definitions and require all branch-protection checks to pass on the release PR.
rows.public_wording: Release changes are subject to repository CI and security workflows.
rows.gap: A workflow definition is not itself a successful run; release claims require the exact PR check record.

rows.requirement: The catalog qualification record distinguishes catalog membership from liveness and eligibility.
rows.verification: Validate the checked-in JSON artifacts and compare their recorded hashes and limitations.
rows.public_wording: The recorded catalog snapshots are bounded observations, not proof that every listed route is runnable.
rows.gap: The snapshots are historical and partial; they do not certify current provider availability.

rows.requirement: Quantified latency, throughput, memory, adoption, or quality claims have reproducible public evidence before publication.
rows.verification: For each metric, locate a reproducible artifact with definition, date, environment, and raw result before changing status.
rows.public_wording: No quantified portfolio claim is currently approved by this matrix unless it resolves to a listed reproducible artifact.
rows.gap: Several existing portfolio documents contain claims whose supporting artifacts are not present in this repository.

rows.requirement: Production readiness, adoption, performance leadership, and model intelligence claims are gated by a released evidence bundle.
rows.verification: Run the release checklist against an exact tagged artifact and attach the resulting bundle and CI records.
rows.public_wording: The repository defines release evidence gates; the current checkout is not authorized to claim all gates passed.
rows.gap: An exact released artifact, signed/checksummed bundle, and complete gate report are still required.

rows.requirement: Local memory and code-graph components have explicit offline-oriented contracts and tests.

evidence.locator: restart, scope, export, and integrity tests

rows.public_wording: The repository contains tested local memory and code-graph components with explicit scope and offline-oriented behavior.
rows.gap: This local contract evidence does not verify the separate quantitative performance claims in the portfolio documents.
